title: SPECIAL PERMITS PREVIOUSLY AUTHORIZED
previewText: Whenever, under the provisions of the Special Clinton Interim District or any prior zoning regulation, the City Planning Commission has authorized any special permit, the status of such special permit shall not be altered by the provisions of this Chapter.
